items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998

ctx.x: You never thought you’d say that, did you?
No, no. Because I’m watching his eyes. And naturally Caruso you see. And just name it, I heard all these, all this. And then we had the piano at the house—
Everybody had a piano at that time. Everybody had a piano.
